text:
GruntWorx should inherit Instead’s reliability mechanisms and shared vocabulary, while defining its own API budgets and vendor mappings.

1. **Rate limits must match the vendor’s accounting.** Instead throttles per connection and API group, plus an app-wide budget. Its configured defaults are 5 document requests/minute and 500 app requests/minute; production overrides these to 60 and 3,000. The group check runs first so rejected jobs do not consume the app budget. Workers and response metrics share the same group resolver, including a budgeted fallback. GruntWorx needs its own equivalent settings and keys.  
   Respect `Retry-After` as either seconds or an HTTP date. The shared worker allows 10 retries, but throttle rescheduling resets the retry count: this is **not a wall-clock deadline**. See [throttle configuration](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/initializers/sidekiq.rb:101), [retry policy](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:9), and [header parsing](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/base_client.rb:121).

2. **Webhooks need a bounded reconciliation fallback.** The sweep runs every 30 minutes and selects uploaded documents still `sent` after one hour or `processing` after 12 hours. It stops selecting them after two days, leaving their state unchanged; these thresholds support provider overrides. Instead reads paginated year folders, then individually fetches candidates absent from the listing—absence from a folder alone does not mean deletion. An individual 404 maps to `archived`.  
   Webhooks and polling use the same status mapper, which ignores duplicate/refused backward transitions and supports recovery from `error` to `processed`. Reconciliation jobs make one attempt (`retry: 0`); subsequent sweeps provide another opportunity within the window. Preserve these explicit bounds and monitor documents that age out. See [candidate windows](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/queries/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_candidates_query.rb:8), [pagination and fallback](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_statuses_worker.rb:45), and [shared mapper](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/apply_processing_status.rb:33).

3. **Keep failure reasons vendor-neutral and separate from retry decisions.** The shared vocabulary is `unexpected`, `no_active_connection`, `network_error`, `unauthorized`, `api_error`, `exceeded`, `forbidden`, and `encrypted`. Instead maps `password_required` to `encrypted`; an unknown indexing refusal still produces `error`, with no mapped reason. Its terminal upload refusals generally map to `api_error`, with explicit exceptions for quota, authorization, and policy failures. GruntWorx should translate its codes into this vocabulary and distinguish temporary throttling from exhausted quota. Recovery transitions clear old reasons; a fresh send resets previous processing/upload outcomes. See [document state machines](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:10) and [refusal classification](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/refusals_helper.rb:8).

4. **Signed-URL cassettes need both time control and secret scrubbing.** Tagged cassette replays freeze time at the original recording timestamp, preventing recorded upload targets from expiring merely because the test runs later. Recording new cassettes uses real time. The VCR hook scrubs policies, AWS credentials/signatures, and client secrets from request and response bodies. OAuth token and bearer scrubbing is currently **Instead-host-specific**, so GruntWorx must extend it. If GruntWorx puts signatures in URL query parameters, add explicit coverage: this hook scrubs bodies and the Instead authorization header. The transfer itself sends no TaxDome OAuth grant to storage. See [clock handling](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/support/vcr_fixed_time.rb:3), [scrubbing](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/spec_helper.rb:164), and [upload transport](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/base_client.rb:243).

5. **Entity matching should prefer reuse and refuse ambiguity.** Instead reuses a stored active entity across tax years, scoped by firm, taxpayer, and entity type. Name matching considers only active, unlinked entities of that type and links only a unique match. It normalizes punctuation, whitespace, case, and selected business legal-form spellings. Personal matching tries swapped first/last names only when the primary search finds nothing; account-name matching is allowed only for a sole contact. Ambiguous matches remain unlinked and emit distinct metrics. Preserve these safeguards and verify GruntWorx’s identity model: Instead’s entity creation is explicitly non-idempotent. See [stored identity lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/find_entity.rb:26), [matching rules](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/link_entity_by_name.rb:47), and [creation semantics](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/create_entity.rb:3).

These findings come from the existing code and configuration; GruntWorx’s actual API guarantees still need validation. No files were changed.
